arts.ttl: Barcelona superstar to play 15-20 minutes vs Alaves after a month out with injury
arts.sum: It was a day of good news and bad news for FC Barcelona today in terms of injuries. The positive was that star midfielder Pedri, who has been out since late October, trained with the group, with everything suggesting that he will receive the medical green light for the weekend La Liga clash vs Alaves.
